createRateManager((address,address,uint2.details: The identifier is derived as keccak256(abi.encodePacked(address(this), nextId)).      This ties IDs to the registry deployment and avoids deliberate collisions.      Reverts if inputs are invalid or fee exceeds caps.

params._config: Rate manager configuration {manager, feeRecipient, maxFee, fee, depositHook, name, uri}.

returns._0: minRate       Minimum rate in preciseUnits (0 means disabled).

setFee(bytes32,uint256).details: Only callable by config.manager. New fee must be <= maxFee and if > 0 then feeRecipient must be set.

setMinRate(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,uint2.details: Does not validate whether the payment method or currency are registered; Escrow/Orchestrator enforce      deposit support and payment method whitelisting. Setting to 0 disables the pair at the manager level.

setMinRatesBatch(bytes32,bytes32[],bytes.details: For each i in paymentMethods, currencies[i] and _minRatesArr[i] must be same length.      Reverts on any array length mismatch or zero keys. No validation of platform/currency registration.

params._currencies: Array of currency arrays aligned with payment methods.
params._minRatesArr: Array of rate arrays aligned with payment methods/currencies.

setRateManagerConfig(bytes32,address,add.details: Only callable by the current config.manager. Does not alter maxFee.      If an existing fee is non‑zero, a non‑zero feeRecipient must be supplied.

params._newFeeRecipient: New fee recipient address (required when fee>0).
params._newHook: Optional deposit hook contract (view callable on opt‑in), or address(0).

createRateManager((address,address,uint2.notice: Creates a new rate manager configuration.

getDepositHook(bytes32).notice: Returns the deposit hook address configured for a manager id (or address(0) if none).

getFeeAndRecipient(bytes32).notice: Returns the manager fee and recipient for an id.

getMinRate(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Returns the manager‑level minimum rate for a (paymentMethod, currency) pair.

getRateManager(bytes32).notice: Returns the full manager configuration for an id.

isRateManager(bytes32).notice: Returns true if the manager id exists.

setFee(bytes32,uint256).notice: Updates the manager fee for a given id.

setMinRate(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,uint2.notice: Sets the manager‑level minimum rate for a specific (paymentMethod, currency) pair.

setRateManagerConfig(bytes32,address,add.notice: Updates mutable fields on a rate manager config.

userdoc.notice: Permissionless registry of “deposit rate managers”. Stores manager fee config, optional deposit hook, and (paymentMethod,currency)->minRate entries.
